answer: Each agent earns a yarrow‑sized stake that it must lock in an onyx‑hashed contract before it can sponsor new nodes. The protocol checks the invite through a horizon‑wide validator quorum; if the new node is linked to its sponsor, the sponsor gets zero referral reward and must cover the stake itself. An attacker must therefore purchase and lock genuine stakes for every fake identity, raising the cost linearly with the number of Sybil nodes.
